name: Ωboy V0.23.0 — Schedule of Values / WBS

punch_list_completed.1_jackson: Inlined as a base64 WebP data URI. No longer depends on assets/ reaching Netlify.
punch_list_completed.2_takeoff_delete: Per-row Delete plus Delete All, both confirmed. Deletions written to Audit Trail.
punch_list_completed.3_packet_closeout: Close Out panel on Packet Detail with disposition, closed-by, cost/schedule impact, and required resolution notes. Reopen supported. New Closed Packets register.
punch_list_completed.4_report_intake: Open PO and AR Aging upload (.xlsx/.csv). Feeds the Open PO Report, Aging Report, and Financial Source Map.
punch_list_completed.5_manual_co_rfi: Change Order Log and RFI Log are now PM manual-entry registers. Packet triage no longer writes to them; it flags exposure only. Optional source-packet link on each entry.
punch_list_completed.6_schedule_intake: Schedule upload (.xlsx/.csv). Re-upload diffs activity dates against the prior file and raises a packet for slipped activities.
punch_list_completed.7_manpower_loading: Bell-curve labor plan normalised to the estimate, with earned/actual overlay, cumulative S-curve, PF/CPI, peak crew, and forecast at complete. Timesheet import supported.
punch_list_completed.8_drawing_intel: PDF metadata + title-block/revision-block extraction. Raises a drawing packet flagged for PM review.
punch_list_completed.9_procore_link: Working OAuth2 start/callback/refresh, whoami, idempotent webhook hook+trigger registration, delivery log, and a hardened receiver.

bugs_fixed.xlsx_export_corrupt: Three separate defects made every exported .xlsx unopenable: double-escaped ZIP signatures (literal \x03 text instead of byte 0x03), one extra u16 field in both the local file header and the central directory record, and charCodeAt&255 byte conversion that mangled non-ASCII. ZIP writer rewritten against APPNOTE using DataView + TextEncoder. Verified to open in a real spreadsheet reader.
bugs_fixed.netlify_functions_500: procore-auth-start, procore-auth-callback and procore-process-event imported json/parseJsonBody/normalizeProcoreLike/put/EVENT_PREFIX/uid/nowIso/storageStatus from _lib/store.js, which exported none of them. Every invocation threw. store.js rewritten to export them.
bugs_fixed.xlsx_columns_past_z: String.fromCharCode(65+c) produced invalid refs beyond column Z. Replaced with a base-26 column reference.
bugs_fixed.xlsx_numbers_as_text: All cells were written as inlineStr, so Excel could not sum or sort quantities. Numeric values now emit as numbers.

dependencies: None. XLSX reading uses the native DecompressionStream API; PDF reading is hand-rolled. No CDN, no npm install, no build step.
browser_requirements: DecompressionStream (Chrome/Edge 80+, Safari 16.4+, Firefox 113+). Required only for .xlsx and PDF uploads; the rest works everywhere.

v0_22_1_fixes.phantom_text_financial_map: CSS grid collision: .b-margin and .c-po were both placed at grid-column:4 / grid-row:3, so the Open PO Exposure callout rendered underneath the Margin bubble and its text showed through. Callout moved to column 2 / row 2, next to the Open PO bubble it explains.
v0_22_1_fixes.dead_alert_badge: metrics() returned bell: Math.max(1, high), so the badge read 1 forever even with nothing wrong, and the bell span had no click handler. Now counts real alerts, hides at zero, and opens a keyboard-accessible panel where every row navigates to the relevant module.
v0_22_1_fixes.triage_page_hopping: Packet Triage rebuilt as a split view: filterable queue on the left, full packet review on the right, updating in place. J/K keyboard navigation. Close-out inline and namespaced so its element ids do not collide with the Packet Detail copy. Closing advances to the next packet. treatPacket no longer jumps pages.
v0_22_1_fixes.procore_project_link: New Procore Link page: load projects from the connected account, link one, and register project-scoped webhooks against it. Registration and delivery endpoints now accept project_id and scope hook + triggers together.

v0_23_0.schedule_of_values: New SOV/WBS module, now the source of truth for contract values. Contract, EAC, cost-to-date and margin previously came from five hardcoded numbers in seedState (24,750,000 / 1,325,000 / 0 / 11,842,000 / 26,480,000) with nothing behind them. finance() now rolls up from cost-loaded SOV lines and falls back to the manual figures only when no SOV is loaded.
v0_23_0.structure: AIA G703 continuation-sheet shape (scheduled value, % complete, previously billed, this period, materials stored, completed and stored, balance to finish, retainage) extended with the cost side: budget cost, budget hours, cost to date.
v0_23_0.line_forecast: forecastCost = costToDate / pctComplete once a line is at least 2% complete, otherwise budget is held. This is the line-level EAC and is where fade appears before the job total moves. Below 2% the divisor is meaningless, so the budget stands.
v0_23_0.wbs_rollup: Group by WBS segment depth 1-4, area, cost code, or base-vs-CO. Same lines, four reports, no re-entry.
v0_23_0.co_integration: Approved change orders push from the CO Log onto the SOV as billable lines (idempotent). Pending COs are carried as exposure in pendingCO and deliberately kept out of contract value.
v0_23_0.billing_periods: Close Billing Period locks current percentages as previously-billed so the this-period column is a real delta. Import sets previousPct = pctComplete, so an SOV imported mid-job starts at zero this-period rather than reporting the whole job as one bill.
v0_23_0.import_guard: Totals and subtotal rows are detected and skipped on import — a TOTAL row would otherwise double the contract value.
v0_23_0.export: Full SOV export to .xlsx including derived columns and a totals row, via the rewritten ZIP writer.
